name: Serenz
paymentPlan: 10% at booking, 60% during construction, 30% after handover
overview: Rising majestically as a 50-storey architectural masterpiece, Serenz by Danube Properties represents the pinnacle of contemporary residential living in Dubai's prestigious Jumeirah Village Circle. This exceptional vertical community introduces a new standard of urban sophistication, seamlessly blending modern design principles with luxurious comfort. Offering fully furnished studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, Serenz stands as both a premier residential destination and a strategic investment opportunity, designed around the core principles of accessibility, scale, and structured planning that define modern Dubai living.
